schoolStoriesOnly.title: School Stories Only
schoolStoriesOnly.desc: This is a school-focused community. Every story must be about a school experience — attending school during or after cancer treatment, keeping up with classes, navigating relationships with classmates or teachers, returning after time away, remote learning, IEPs or 504 plans, extracurriculars, or any other school-related challenge or success. Stories not connected to school will not be approved, no matter how meaningful. If your story touches on something outside of school, please connect it back to how it affected your school life.

beKind.title: Be Kind and Supportive
beKind.desc: Share your authentic experiences, and if you respond to others, focus on encouragement and support. Treat everyone with compassion, empathy, and respect.

noMedicalAdvice.title: No Medical Advice
noMedicalAdvice.desc: This is a place for peer support, sharing coping strategies, and finding comfort. It is not a substitute for professional medical care or counseling. Please consult your healthcare team for medical questions or treatments.

protectPrivacy.title: Protect Your Privacy (and Others')
protectPrivacy.desc: Do not share sensitive personal information like school names, addresses, phone numbers, or passwords. Respect the privacy of friends, teachers, and family by keeping them anonymous. Avoid sharing photos or videos that reveal identities without permission.

respectJourney.title: Respect Everyone's Journey
respectJourney.desc: Everyone's experience with cancer and school is unique. Use inclusive, non-judgmental language, and avoid judging or comparing others' journeys.

zeroTolerance.title: Zero Tolerance for Bullying or Hate
zeroTolerance.desc: Harassment, hate speech, bullying, or inappropriate content will not be tolerated. Moderators review all stories; violations may result in removal or account suspension. If you see concerning content, please report it.

safeLanguage.title: Safe Language and Tone
safeLanguage.desc: Avoid triggering language or graphic medical details. Share what's helpful and safe for others to read.
